newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia Dec retail sales up 12.2 pct, 29.5 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Croatia Dec retail sales up 12.2 pct, 29.5 pct y/y.

text.p: Croatia's December retail sales rose 12.2 percent after a slight dip in November and shrank stocks by 3.6 percent, the State Statistics Bureau reported on Friday.
Retail sales jumped 29.5 percent from a year ago, but stocks were also 18.7-percent higher.
Some 400 leading retailers forecast sales to fall by almost one-fifth after the end-of-year spending spree subsides in January.
December retail price inflation was 0.2 percent and 2.5 percent year-on-year.
Leather, footwear, rubber and plastics sales declined 12.3 percent, unaffected by December buying. Varnishes and chemicals dipped 1.4 percent and construction materials also had slower sales.
Car and spare part sales ballooned 43.4 percent, shrinking stocks by 28.5 percent.
